description: The card of a file change (lib/approval-preview.mjs): the bounds (20 files, 200 rows, 400 characters, 120,000 characters, 500 characters of a refusal), a line cut at a character and not inside one, the guard of every file of the call and the digest of the arguments, and the body of a private key hidden by its place in the old and the new text, judged by tests/verify-approval-preview.mjs. After the audit of PR #103: the key in one line, PGP's frames, the rows' keys hidden before they are cut. Second round of PR #103: the key machinery is one state machine (frames, parts, lines), shared by the masker, the card and the answer of edit_file. Third round of PR #103: what is hidden is what looks like a key (looksLikeKey: tokens, the characters of base64, what a key is wrapped in), and the card says how many rows it hid (hiddenKeyRows). Round 4 of PR #103: what is hidden in a body is every run of 16 characters or more of base64, wherever it stands (hideKeyRuns, hideBodyRow, hideKeyPart); the decoration stays.
